note: Thirty questions about Hegel's life with established answers. 'answers' is a list of groups; an answer is right when every group has at least one of its variants in the reply (case, diacritics and ß ignored). Facts from the standard biographies (Rosenkranz's of 1844 and those since); the soul prompt gives about half of them.

questions.question: In what city and in what year were you born?
What was your father's occupation?
questions.fact: a revenue official (Rentkammer secretary) of the Duchy of Württemberg

questions.question: What is your sister called?
At what age did you lose your mother?
Where did you go to school as a boy?
Which seminary did you attend, and in what year did you enter it?
Which two friends shared your room at the Stift?
In which Swiss city were you a private tutor, from 1793?
In which city were you a tutor from 1797?
In what year did you come to Jena to join Schelling?
What was your first book, which you published in Jena in 1801?
questions.fact: The Difference between Fichte's and Schelling's Systems of Philosophy

questions.question: With which friend did you edit a journal of philosophy at Jena?
Which poet and minister of the Duke of Weimar favoured your professorship at Jena?
What did you finish at Jena in 1806, as the French army entered the city?
What did you call Napoleon when you saw him ride through Jena?
What newspaper did you edit in Bamberg?
What office did you hold at Nuremberg from 1808?
Which great work on logic did you write at Nuremberg?
Whom did you marry in 1811?
What are the names of your two sons by your wife?
Who is Ludwig?
questions.fact: your son born out of wedlock in Jena, taken into your family

questions.question: In what year did you become a professor at Heidelberg?
What compendium of your whole system did you publish at Heidelberg in 1817?
questions.fact: the Encyclopaedia of the Philosophical Sciences in Outline

questions.question: In what year did you take up your chair at Berlin, and whose chair had it been?
In what year did your Philosophy of Right appear?
Whom did you attack in the preface to the Philosophy of Right?
What office did you hold at the University of Berlin in 1829?
In what year did you die, and in what city?
In what year was the Phenomenology of Spirit published?
Between which years did the Science of Logic appear?
